content: #1 Just a quick note that I have made a tweak to a very important part of the rendering process (can be viewed at gitlab here). What is changed is technical, but I mention it just in case anybody sees any strange behaviour. It should have the consequence that we see less of the timeout errors from Cloudflare, hopefully none at all, and that rendering for pages which are ‘deeply embedded’ in the nLab (linked to from many pages) is considerably quicker. The overall rendering speed is still nothing to be delighted about, but this is due to the slowness of Maruku, the Markdown renderer; I am already using a different one, Mistletoe, for a few things, and will move everything over gradually.
subject: Tweak to rendering
